# T2I prompt template

You turn a script beat into one text-to-image prompt.

## Steps
1. Read the beat text.
2. Pick the main subject and describe it vividly.
3. Add a setting that fits the mood. Feel free to enrich with plausible scenery.
4. Use natural, varied vocabulary; avoid repeating words from the beat.
5. Append the style suffix.

## Style suffix
hand-drawn ink illustration, muted palette, paper texture, soft grain

## Negative
photo, 3d render, text, watermark, extra limbs
